evidence: R1284 ARM GCC loses 2.1-2.4% scan throughput for all three real sections with fixed image controls and clean A/A. cs_decode_full_insn grows 1260 to 1952 bytes; later code shifts +688. ARM scan still calls this full function.
control: Compile original and candidate with cs_decode_full_insn in a separate executable section, alongside untouched original-layout baseline and candidate. Verify all other text symbol addresses and sizes match within the separated pair and capture full assembly. Measure original baseline, A/A, original candidate, separated baseline and separated candidate on the same runner.
panels: Three ARM sections, scan only, original images plus fixed inode/addresses, 21 balanced forward/reverse cycles, target 100ms per measured process CPU pass.
interpretation: Compare candidate/base within each layout. Recovery with matching surrounding text supports a placement contribution; persistent loss warrants instruction-path/frame analysis. Neither outcome alone identifies PMU-level mechanisms.
